items.title: AI Is the New Book Burning
items.summary: Humanity at stake in Anthropic’s mass book destruction, remembering gallerist Francisco Correa Cordero, pickleball murals in Pittsburgh, and more.

items.title: Lubov Gallery Founder Francisco Correa Cordero Dies at 37
items.summary: In the decade since starting his New York gallery, he mounted exhibitions of artists including Mira Dayal, Shannon Cartier Lucy, Parker Ito, Bryce Kroll, and Xingzi Gu.

items.title: Eric Carle Museum Workers Push for Union Vote
items.summary: Employees at the Massachusetts museum established by the children’s book artist behind “The Very Hungry Caterpillar” cited poor working conditions and under-staffing in a statement.

items.title: Sharmistha Ray Transforms Pickleball Courts Into Stunning Artworks
items.summary: The artist's fully playable installation "Geometry of Play" spreads over three courts in downtown Pittsburgh.
